LanguageData.CC_Settings_AwayQuests: Quests out on the world map: {0}
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AwayQuests_Tip: How often the storyteller offers quests that send the colony out on the world map (a camp to raid, a stash or a ruin to find, a site to visit, a trade request at a town), against quests that play out at home. At 100% they come as the game has it. Lower, each one weighs that share of what it would when the storyteller picks a quest, so more of the quests offered play out at home: at 50%, a colony offered six quests in ten out on the map is offered about four in ten. The storyteller offers as many quests as before. Work sites, which come on a slot of their own, come at this share of their usual rate. Quests given another way (a story, an ending, a ritual, a decree, an item, a book, a trader, a scanner, or a mod's chain of quests) are never held back. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AwayQuests: At 100%, as the game has it. Lower, more of the quests offered play out at home.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_QuestSites: How far quest sites may be
LanguageData.CC_Settings_QuestSites_Tip: When a quest picks a place for its site (a camp, a stash, a ruin, a wreck), how far from home it may be. The game picks between 7 and 27 tiles away unless the quest asks for its own range. Nearer: at most about three fifths of the farthest (16 tiles of 27). Near: at most about a third (9 tiles), and as close as 4. Where no place that near fits, the site is picked as the game would, so no quest is lost to the setting. Quests that pick their place another way, and trade requests (the town is where it is), stay as the game has them. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_QuestSites_AsTheGame_Tip: Quest sites between 7 and 27 tiles away, as the game picks them.
LanguageData.CC_QuestSites_Nearer_Tip: Quest sites at most about 16 tiles away instead of 27; the nearest as the game has it.
LanguageData.CC_QuestSites_Near_Tip: Quest sites at most about 9 tiles away, and as close as 4.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_QuestSites_AsTheGame: Quest sites as far as the game puts them.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_QuestSites_Nearer: Quest sites at most about 16 tiles away, from the game's 27.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_QuestSites_Near: Quest sites at most about 9 tiles away.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OwnTimerShare: ... and on Rimfolk's own timer besides: {0}
LanguageData.CC_Settings_OwnTimerShare_Tip: With the storyteller drawing Rimfolk's events, some can also come on Rimfolk's own timer, on top of what the storyteller draws. At 0%, none: only the storyteller brings them, as before. At 100%, the timer brings one about every 4 days besides; at 50%, about every 8 days; at 25%, about every 16 days. The timer waits while a question of Rimfolk's is not answered or a fight is on, and the storyteller seldom draws one of Rimfolk's events in the day and a half after one came.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_OwnTimerShare: At 0%, only the storyteller draws them. Higher, more of Rimfolk's events come besides.
